chapter_explainer_body:
Every Italian line below is spoken by the learner. The micro-situation supplies only the context needed to license the line; it is not part of the shadowed text. English is a natural gloss, not a word-for-word structural explanation.

This draft assumes that its short A0–A2 vocabulary and grammar are already licensed. That assumption must be replaced by an exact audit against the canonical corpus and its control sheets before these items receive final IDs or enter the app.
chapter_explainer_group_overview: 1.1 Signal non-understanding; 1.2 Request repetition; 1.3 Control pace and segmentation; 1.4 Ask meaning, spelling or name; 1.5 Check intended meaning; 1.6 Retrieval: choose the repair strategy
